stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $350 \times 502$ is divided by $19$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $350 \equiv 8$ and $502 \equiv 8 \pmod{19}$. So the product is $\equiv 8 \times 8 = 64 \equiv 7 \pmod{19}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
